hero_prop_criteria.center_of_focus: The story, a shot or a character's attention centres on the object.
hero_prop_criteria.high_frequency: The object is present in more than one scene/act.
hero_prop_criteria.transfer: The object passes between two characters.

scenes.heading: EXT. SABA ELIOR’S COURTYARD — LATE MORNING

hero_props.name: Yonah’s small lunch
hero_props.description: Yonah’s five barley loaves and two fish, first wrapped in his bundle, then given to Andrew and Jesus, multiplied for the crowd, and gathered afterward as leftovers. The prop changes form through the miracle but remains the same offered lunch.
hero_props.reason: This is the central miracle prop: Yonah’s small gift drives the plot, is transferred to Jesus, multiplied, distributed, and becomes the lesson Miri applies to her own cakes.

hero_props.name: Honey-date cakes in cloth bundle
hero_props.description: Miri’s three honey-date cakes, wrapped in cloth. They begin as something she guards, then become the object through which she practices generosity by sharing with Tav and Nim.
hero_props.reason: The cakes carry the episode’s central lesson about opening one’s hands; they are repeatedly discussed, protected, remembered, and finally given away.

hero_props.name: Linen basket with folded linen

hero_props.reason: It appears across the village and Saba scenes, is physically handed from Ima to Miri, and delivers the linen to Saba while carrying the guarded cakes.

hero_props.name: Miracle baskets
hero_props.description: The baskets used by the disciples and children to distribute the multiplied bread and collect the leftovers, culminating in twelve full baskets.
hero_props.reason: The baskets are central visual and handling props in the miracle sequence: they carry the multiplying bread, pass through many hands, and embody the abundance left over.

hero_props.name: Small scroll of the loaves and fish
hero_props.description: The selected scroll tied with barley-colored cord and sealed with a loaf-and-two-fish mark. It opens the miraculous hillside story and later rests glowing on its shelf.
hero_props.reason: The scroll is the magical/thematic gateway into the feeding miracle, is deliberately selected by Saba, and returns as an important object after the vision.

hero_props.name: Tav’s broken toy cart
hero_props.description: Tav’s small toy cart with a loose wheel. It appears broken when Miri first withholds the cake, then is repaired after she returns and chooses generosity; the loose peg functions as part of the repair set.
hero_props.reason: The cart recurs as Tav’s need beyond hunger and becomes a concrete second act of giving when Miri stays to help repair it.
